heading: Form 141 for TDS: Understanding the New Challan-cum-Statement
tldr: Form 141 is a new unified challan-cum-statement introduced under the Income Tax Act 2025 to simplify TDS compliance.
It combines the payment of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) with the submission of its related statement into a single form.
This form is primarily applicable to specified TDS transactions carried out by individuals and Hindu Undivided Families (HUFs).
Key transactions covered typically include payments for rent, professional fees, and contractual work exceeding certain thresholds.
Taxpayers must familiarise themselves with the new form and adhere to the specified deadlines to ensure smooth compliance and avoid penalties.
caption:
Got a new rule about how you pay certain taxes? The government has a new Form 141 to make paying some TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) easier, especially if you're an individual or a Hindu Undivided Family. This single form combines payment and reporting, simplifying things for rent, professional fees, and contract work. Learn how this change impacts you and avoid any last-minute stress.
